versions.changelog: Add behavior examples and proxy evals for trust-first JD shopping decisions.
P1: rewrite install-conversion summary and standardize shopping safety boundaries.
Retag v2 release so the general shopping tag also resolves to the safe cart-preparation version.
Harden v2 browser automation boundaries: stop at cart, remove order-preview and checkout actions, align metadata, add UI metadata and privacy rules.
Restore agentic shopping utility: support logged-in cart preparation with user consent while keeping login, checkout settlement, final confirmation, and payment user-controlled.
Restore JD Shopping display name while keeping the clean public-page decision-support safety boundary.
Security-aligned update: public-page decision support only; remove account, cart, checkout, order, and payment automation to reduce scanner risk.
Add matrix cross-sell guidance to route JD users toward the right shopping skill.
Sharpen JD positioning around trust, self-operated buying, and value-for-price decision-making.
Security-aligned public release: low-sensitivity decision-support version without runtime or account-state behavior.
Browser-commerce workflow upgrade: unified OpenClaw browser profile selection, snapshot/re-snapshot rules, commerce extraction order, and platform-specific live-page guidance.

- Adds detailed guidance for authentic product verification, price tracking, and logistics optimization on JD.com.
- Introduces core rules for distinguishing store types, maximizing shopping safety, and effective coupon stacking.
- Features strategies for PLUS membership value, delivery options including same-day, and return/policy advantages.
- Includes a quick reference for authenticity, pricing, and logistics topics.
- Highlights common shopping traps and JD-specific tools for a better shopping experience.
